**Data provenance** tracks the origin and rights of training data.

**Why it matters**:
- **Copyright**: Training on copyrighted data may be infringement
- **Consent**: Personal data requires user consent (GDPR)
- **Quality**: Know which sources produce best results
- **Liability**: If model outputs harmful content, trace it back

**Tracking**:
- Source URL or dataset name
- License type (CC-BY, MIT, proprietary, unknown)
- Collection date and method
- Consent status (opt-in, opt-out, unclear)

**Compatible licenses**: MIT, Apache, CC-BY allow commercial use. CC-BY-NC does not. Unknown = risk.
